audit_items.proof_trace: Read-modify-write race condition: ProposerLookahead() returns a clone (L30), local modifications (L35,L45), then SetProposerLookahead() writes back (L46). Concurrent epoch processing can cause interleaved reads/writes, resulting in lost updates and incorrect proposer indices for epoch N+MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD+1.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker triggers concurrent state transitions via P2P block submission or sync. Two goroutines read the same initial lookahead state, compute different proposer sets (due to timing), and the second write overwrites the first, installing incorrect proposer indices in the beacon state.
